primitives.note: Dark Binding: single-target skillshot damage that lands after its 0.25s cast; the root itself is CC and ignored.
Tormented Shadow: on-cast damage instance plus a tick every 0.5s for 5s (up to 10 further ticks) while the zone persists on the dummy.
Each Tormented Shadow tick scales from its base value up to double as the target's missing-health percentage rises.
Every landed Morgana ability hit (including W's own ticks) triggers Soul Siphon, refunding 5% of W's total cooldown per trigger; simultaneous triggers stack.
Soul Shackles deals an initial hit on cast and, since a stationary dummy cannot break the 3s tether, an identical second magic-damage hit lands automatically 3s later.
Soul Siphon converts 18% of post-mitigation ability damage dealt into self-healing; only relevant if Morgana is the survival-fight subject and lands damage.
Black Shield only absorbs magic damage and grants CC immunity; it deals no damage and is only read in a survival fight where Morgana is the target being kept alive.
Mana costs (Q 50-70, W 70-110, R 100) against Morgana's mana pool can cap total casts inside a 15s all-in, particularly at low levels or without mana items.

needsBespoke.why: The kit's damage-relevant behavior (a skillshot cast, a ticking zone whose tick size depends on target missing-health, a self-referential cooldown-refund loop off every landed hit, and a two-part tethered burst with a guaranteed delayed second hit against an immobile target) is fully expressible as combinations of plain-cast, dot, conditional-damage, cooldown-manipulation, and recast-or-multipart; nothing requires custom engine logic beyond these.

unsettled.question: What is W's actual damage at 0% missing health: half of MorganaW.BaseDamage (as the wiki's 'Minimum Damage Per Tick' states, 9 to 35 +10% AP) or the full BaseDamage+0.2xAP value (as the bin's row literally named MorganaW#TotalMinDamage computes, which numerically equals the wiki's stated MAXIMUM tick)?
options: Use the wiki's stated minimum (BaseDamage halved, +10% AP) as the 0%-missing floor and double it at 100% missing
Use the bin's TotalMinDamage (full BaseDamage, +20% AP) as the 0%-missing floor and double it via MissingHealthAmpPercent to reach the bin's TotalMaxDamage
quotes: {{st|Minimum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9 to 35}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Damage Per Tick|{{ap|9*2 to 35*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*2}}% AP)}}}}

unsettled.question: Is Tormented Shadow's missing-health damage amp recalculated per tick against the dummy's live (falling) health, or fixed once when the zone is cast?
options: Recomputed every 0.5s tick using the target's current health at that moment
Locked in once at cast time and applied identically to every tick of that cast
quotes: increased by {{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}

unsettled.question: Does Soul Siphon's 5%-of-total-cooldown refund shrink Tormented Shadow's cooldown live while it's counting down (letting a second W be cast well before the nominal 12s if enough hits land), or does it only apply once and get consumed at the next cooldown start?
options: Refund is applied immediately to the live, ticking-down cooldown timer, so W can be recast earlier than 12s
Refund accumulates but is only realized the next time the ability enters its cooldown, i.e. does not shorten the current wait
quotes: ''Tormented Shadow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.

unsettled.question: Is Soul Shackles' aftereffect hit a fresh evaluation of MorganaR#TotalDamage at the moment it lands (3s after cast, so it could reflect stat changes mid-fight) or a value snapshotted from the initial cast?
options: Aftereffect recomputes damage (base + 0.8xAP) using stats at the time it lands
Aftereffect reuses the exact damage number rolled at the initial hit
quotes: If a target does not break their tether by the end of its duration, they are dealt the same {{as|magic damage}} again and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration

proposal: Open with R (Soul Shackles) while all cooldowns are fresh, since it is Morgana's largest one-time burst and starts the 3s tether that guarantees a free second hit later.
Immediately follow with W (Tormented Shadow) on the dummy's location for its on-cast hit and to start the 5s, 0.5s-interval tick DoT.
Cast Q (Dark Binding) at the dummy for its flat magic damage.

Let each landed hit (R's initial hit, W's on-cast hit and every subsequent tick, Q's hit) trigger Soul Siphon and shave 5% off W's total cooldown; recast W again as soon as it comes off cooldown to start another full tick cycle within the 15s window.
Recast Q again once its 10s cooldown is up (around the 10-11s mark) for another flat hit.
Allow Soul Shackles' aftereffect (an identical magic-damage hit plus stun) to land automatically ~3s after the initial cast, since the stationary dummy can never break the tether.
Do not cast E (Black Shield) in the damage fight: it deals no damage and only matters for a survival scenario.
Sequence casts to stay within the mana pool, prioritizing the second W cast (main DoT/DPS engine) and Q over any non-damaging spend.
questions: Does the simulator model Soul Siphon's cooldown refund as live-reducing W's ongoing cooldown timer, or only applied at the next cooldown start? This changes how many W casts fit in 15s.

Should the opening order be R into W into Q, or does the intended combo (informed by real play, where Q's root sets up landing other abilities) put Q first even though CC is ignored in this dummy fight?
Should R be assumed available at the start of the 15s fight (i.e., the build/level scenario is a full-cooldown burst check), given its 100-120s cooldown otherwise never permits a second cast?

Is Tormented Shadow's missing-health amp meant to be evaluated per tick against the live, falling dummy health, materially raising total DoT damage over the fight versus a fixed 0%-missing assumption?
